title: L5 Coordinator stress tests — 3-step chain + interrupt/resume
description: Write and run stress tests for Level5Coordinator covering: 3-step command chain (analyze→plan→execute) end-to-end with state persistence (SC-2 from roadmap), mid-chain interrupt and clean resume from checkpoint, concurrent two-session isolation, and unhandled-rejection detection. Record findings in stress-results-l5.json.
action: Create `src-tauri/bin/sidecar/workflow/levels/level5-coordinator.stress.test.js`. Test cases: (1) `executes 3-step chain end-to-end with persistState at each phase boundary` — instantiate Level5Coordinator with mock retriever, call execute({user_request: 'analyze plan execute'}); after each await persistState verify file `<persistDir>/<sessionId>.json` exists with phase ∈ {analyzing, planning, executing, completed}; (2) `resumes cleanly from mid-chain checkpoint` — start execute(), after phase==='planning' kill via Promise.race+abort, instantiate new Level5Coordinator, call execute() with same session_id, expect state.resumed===true and final phase==='completed'; (3) `concurrent two L5 sessions do not corrupt each other's persistState files` — Promise.all of 2 execute() calls with different session_ids, assert each persistDir/<id>.json has correct sessionId field; (4) `unhandled rejections are zero across all 3 cases`. Write findings to `stress-results-l5.json` with same shape as L4 results.

files.change: 4 vitest test cases: 3-step E2E, mid-chain interrupt+resume, concurrent isolation, no unhandled rejections

implementation: Import: `import { describe, test, expect } from 'vitest'; import { Level5Coordinator } from './level5-coordinator.js'; import { SessionManager } from '../session/session-manager.js'; import { createTempSessionRoot, validateNoUnhandledRejections } from '../__tests__/harness/stress-harness.js'; import { l5ThreeStepChain } from '../__tests__/harness/scenarios.js';`
Mock retriever: const mockRetriever = { hybridSearch: async () => [{id:'r1', source:'mock', score:0.9, content:'mock content'}], resolveContext: async (q) => q };

Test 1 (3-step E2E): const tmp = createTempSessionRoot(); const sm = new SessionManager(tmp.path); const l5 = new Level5Coordinator({persist_dir: tmp.path+'/persist'}, undefined, mockRetriever); const state = await l5.execute({user_request:'test', domain:'novel'}); expect(state.decision).toBe('APPROVED'); expect(fs.existsSync(path.join(tmp.path, 'persist', state.session_id+'.json'))).toBe(true); const persisted = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(...)); expect(persisted.phase).toBe('completed');

Test 2 (interrupt+resume): Run l5.execute() but intercept persistState after phase becomes 'planning' to drop the in-memory _coordinatorState. Spawn new Level5Coordinator with same persist_dir, call execute({session_id: <stored>}); expect state.resumed===true; expect final phase==='completed'.

Test 3 (concurrent): const [s1, s2] = await Promise.all([l5_a.execute({user_request:'a', session_id:'sess-a'}), l5_b.execute({user_request:'b', session_id:'sess-b'})]); expect(s1.session_id).toBe('sess-a'); expect(s2.session_id).toBe('sess-b'); read both persist files, assert they have distinct payloads.
Test 4 (no unhandled rejections): Wrap all 3 above in validateNoUnhandledRejections().stop(); expect pass===true.
After tests, write stress-results-l5.json. For interrupt+resume, if it fails, repro hint should reference resume-strategy.js HybridStrategy or coordinator's _tryResume at level5-coordinator.js:389.
